items.briefing:
Asia Pacific leaders are calling for stronger defences against scams, a timely reminder that Australian organisations remain high-value targets. Separately, AI tools are creating new security risks — misconfigured AI models are opening up vulnerabilities that attackers can exploit, and security experts warn that AI systems are stretching traditional trust-based security approaches to their limits. These risks are relevant even for non-technical staff, as AI tools are increasingly embedded in everyday workplace software.

If your organisation uses AI-powered tools, check with your IT team that they have been configured securely and that access is limited to only those who need it.

featured.title: AI is testing the limits of Zero Trust
